llm_top3.reasoning: CHD and FE both delivered clean beats with raised/reaffirmed guidance and structural tailwinds (portfolio actions; 6.4 GW data-center demand), and FBP pairs a strong quarter and target raise with high quant rank. I skip PFGC (rank 1) because its momentum is already extended into all-time highs with insider selling and a GAAP EPS decline, and avoid EA, whose buyout closes at a fixed price.

PFGC.reasoning: All-time highs, multiple price target raises (Citi to $143) and an 8-day rally offset a mixed Q3 GAAP EPS decline and insider selling by the chair.

CHD.reasoning: Q2 beat with organic sales accelerating to 5.8% versus 3% outlook and raised 2026 guidance, plus a JPMorgan target raise to $105.

FBP.reasoning: Q2 EPS $0.62 beat with lower charge-offs, capital returns, new 1-year high and target raised to $31, though one note flags bearish forecasts.

DIS.reasoning: Stock heading for a third straight monthly decline with Jefferies cutting target to $125 and Pixar layoffs; the $1B A+E stake sale to Hearst is a modest positive but small relative to Disney.

FE.reasoning: Q2 EPS/revenue beat, reaffirmed guidance, $6B capital plan and contracted data-center demand up 50% to 6.4 GW, tempered by dividend-coverage concerns.

HD.reasoning: Shares at 52-week lows amid housing deterioration and tariff pressure; leadership realignment is neutral-to-mildly positive but signals need for change.

TROW.reasoning: Q2 EPS beat with record AUM and cost control, but revenue missed estimates and the stock slid on the print.

SRE.reasoning: Pre-earnings positioning with LNG/data-center demand tailwinds offset by reported damage at the ECA LNG plant and analysts flagging the stock above fair value after a 65% run.

EA.reasoning: The $55B Saudi PIF go-private deal has all approvals and closes Aug 4, so shares are pinned at the fixed deal price with little further upside.

NI.reasoning: Mostly routine 13F filings and dividend notes; analysts expect a y/y earnings decline into the Aug 5 print, offset by a Zacks upgrade note.
